title: NYCBSDCon 2014: Serving one-third of the Internet via FreeBSD
summary: Scott Long of Netflix presents the architecture of the OpenConnect content delivery network at NYCBSDCon 2014. He explains why Netflix runs FreeBSD 10 on its appliances and what the future holds.
why: Cited as the primary source for why Netflix uses FreeBSD and UFS rather than ZFS on its CDN boxes, and for its GPL reasoning.

quote.text: Actually it turns out they don't really have a need for most of the features of ZFS.
